Roncato.

Product film · 2026

For Roncato, with Plasma. I directed a product film built around movement, geometry and the rhythm of the frame.

Watch on Instagram ↗

The idea was to make everything move together: the luggage, the geometry of the set, the rhythm of the frame.

Before the shoot, I worked with Plasma for Roncato, using Gemini to develop visual references. I then built the storyboard shot by shot around the actual location.

By the time we got on set, we knew what we were working towards. Filippo Cinotti, our director of photography, helped turn those ideas into real images.

While I was focused on the shots, Michele Trevisani kept the set on schedule and Tommaso held things together behind the scenes.

On set and behind the camera during the Roncato campaign.
